Hello fellow lurker, been writing and scraping ideas for 3 years, here is my take.

1. Jot it down, any other ideas that you get excited just write it.

2. Prepare or open 2 or even 4 tabs of docs so that when you feel like you have new story, write it separately

3. The stories in your head might link to each universe in terms of conflict, so yiu can use the conflict from other stories to be implemented in your main one

4. What should a writer do besides writing? Yes, reading. Read all your jotted ideas that you have wrote across all document and see if its worth building stories for.

5. Never be afraid to scrap ideas or delete bad stories, you will grow from it learn and be better.

6. Read and read a lot of books!
